title: PractitionerGroupsResponse
description: Response containing groups that a practitioner belongs to. Each group represents a group operational value with core group data and metadata.

data.description: Array of groups the practitioner belongs to. Each group is a GroupOVResponse containing the group's operational value data.

totalCount.description: Total number of groups the practitioner belongs to (if available). May be null if the total count is not provided.

GroupOVResponse.description: Represents a group operational value that the practitioner belongs to. Contains the group's core identifiers, operational data, and contributing slice information.

certifyGroupId.description: The unique Certify identifier for the group (certifyPractitionerId equivalent for groups)

tenantId.description: The tenant identifier that owns this group relationship

data.description: Core group operational value data including name, NPI, TIN, active status, and other group attributes

contributingSlices.description: Internal metadata about data sources that contributed to this group's operational value. Structure is implementation-specific.

self.description: Link to the current page of results

next.description: Link to the next page of results, or null if this is the last page

prev.description: Link to the previous page of results, or null if this is the first page
